data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出可自维护的分层经验图记忆，借助成功/失败反馈持续改写，并在后续任务中检索复用，属方法类RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: a typed reflector crystallizing procedures from successes and pitfalls from failures
scope_support.object_quote: self-maintaining memory that organizes experience into a three-layer graph of atomic skills and code snippets, task workflows and generalized meta-frameworks
scope_support.persistence_quote: agents can self-evolve at test time by accumulating experience: retrieving relevant memories before acting and writing new lessons back afterwards
